subject.title: [Feature]: 内置健壮性机制：Watchdog、全局错误处理、自动恢复

question: Should OpenClaw core own a built-in Gateway watchdog and recovery policy, and which actions should be default, opt-in, or out of scope?
rationale: The request changes core failure semantics, config surface, automatic repair authority, and notification behavior, so source inspection cannot choose the product/security boundary safely.

options.title: Keep As Umbrella Design
options.body: Use this issue to coordinate the core recovery policy while reviewing narrower PRs and issues against the approved design.

options.title: Split Then Close
options.body: Move each remaining slice to a specific canonical issue and close this only after no broad product/security context remains unique here.

options.title: Keep Recovery External
options.body: Document external supervisor or plugin-based recovery as the supported path and reject new core watchdog semantics for now.

recommendation.title: Keep As Umbrella Design
recommendation.body: Use this issue to coordinate the core recovery policy while reviewing narrower PRs and issues against the approved design.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete has the strongest history across Gateway health, restart, diagnostics, docs, and daemon lifecycle surfaces.
